description: This Python script loads environment variables, lists files in a specified folder, and calculates a suitability score for filenames based on a search text. It includes functions for listing files and scoring filenames, and a main block that interacts with the user to perform the search and display sorted results.

methods.name: list_files_in_folder
methods.description: Returns a list of files in the specified folder, handling errors for missing folder or permission issues.

methods.name: calculate_suitability_score
methods.description: Calculates a score indicating how well a filename matches the search text, considering exact match, prefix, and substring occurrences.
